Hawaii Vacation Packing List
June 10th - June 20th, 2024

Essential Items:
- Swimwear
- Sunscreen (SPF 30+ recommended)
- Hiking gear (for Diamond Head hike)
- Casual outfits (lightweight, breathable clothing)
- Camera
- Travel documents (passport, ID, flight information, hotel reservations)

Additional Recommended Items:
- Beach towel
- Reef-safe sunscreen (required for Hanauma Bay)
- Water shoes
- Hat and sunglasses
- Light rain jacket (for potential showers)
- Insect repellent
- Reusable water bottle
- Snorkeling gear (optional, can be rented at Hanauma Bay)
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Evening attire (for luau on June 16)
- Medications and first aid supplies
- Power adapter/charger
- Beach bag
